source: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)

players.product: SATA and PCIe 3.0 / 4.0 / 5.0 NVMe SSD controller chips (consumer, industrial and enterprise; enterprise PCIe 5.0 in mass-production testing) and UFS 3.1 embedded storage controllers

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue rose 13.06% YoY as storage demand recovered and PC-OEM wins ramped, with PCIe 3.0, PCIe 4.0 and enterprise SATA controller shipments rising markedly; net profit attributable rose 20.41% and net profit excluding non-recurring items 130.43%. Main-business gross margin was 50.52%, up 3.12 percentage points.

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: By product in 2025: data storage controller chips rose 26.47% on higher sales volume (gross margin 54.25%), while AIoT signal processing and transmission chips fell 47.17% as downstream customers adjusted purchasing plans (gross margin 17.84%). Main-business revenue outside mainland China was RMB 610,407,492.79 (+17.22%, gross margin 55.69%).

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data storage controller output rose 36.98%, sales volume 23.01% and inventory 117.90% in 2025, as the company built stock and downstream demand grew.
quarterly_data.figure: storage controllers: output 7,351.91 ten-thousand units, sales 6,023.84 ten-thousand units, inventory 2,454.52 ten-thousand units

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers were 63.37% of 2025 sales; the largest 20.31%, then 13.86%, 12.32%, 9.72% and 7.17%; the third-largest (12.32% of sales) is a related party; customer names not disclosed.
quarterly_data.figure: top-5 customers RMB 84,098.94 ten-thousand, 63.37% of 2025 sales; related party 12.32%

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Top five suppliers were 93.26% of 2025 purchases; the largest, a wafer foundry, alone was 76.21%, then 6.73%, 4.97%, 3.20% and 2.14%; none is a related party; supplier names not disclosed. Wafers were 62.10% of main-business cost and packaging and test 30.37% (fabless model).
quarterly_data.figure: top-5 suppliers RMB 93,619.35 ten-thousand, 93.26% of 2025 purchases; largest (a foundry) 76.21%

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply: Maxio increased strategic stocking - year-end 2025 inventory rose 86.61% and was 24.48% of total assets, and prepayments rose 134.51% mainly on payments to wafer suppliers.
quarterly_data.figure: inventory RMB 57,651.85 ten-thousand (24.48% of total assets, +86.61%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D expense rose 18.25% and was 37.88% of revenue, with 659 R&D staff (83.74% of employees); the IPO-funded next-generation data storage controller R&D and industrialization project was 76.05% invested and is scheduled for December 2026.

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (annual report): its embedded UFS controller has been introduced smoothly at handset makers and will ship in volume this year; it plans to bring PCIe Gen6 SSD controllers and UFS 5.0 embedded controllers to its consumer customers (covering UFS 2.2 / 3.1 / 4.1 / 5.0), and to move its enterprise line - the enterprise PCIe Gen5 SSD controller is in mass-production testing - to PCIe Gen6 and Gen7 controllers and through cloud-provider and server-maker certification.

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Market position: the company says it held about 25% of 2024 independent SSD-controller shipments (second globally) and about 12.5% of the global SSD-controller market including non-independent vendors, and that its 2025 shipments rose markedly; it widened its supply share at mainstream PC-OEMs from a single product to several series.
quarterly_data.figure: about 25% of 2024 independent SSD-controller shipments; about 12.5% overall

quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products: the MAP180X consumer PCIe 5.0 SSD controller series launched in 2025 and new-generation storage controllers began volume shipments; the first UFS 3.1 controller entered mass production. In AIoT, the new-generation automotive perception signal processing chip passed AEC-Q100 qualification and received a supplier nomination (design win) from mainstream domestic automakers, and the MAV0106 vision SoC reached the mass-production tape-out standard.
